Name: Samantha - Gender Swapped Sam
Author: bingbongsingalong
Description:
Edit 10/11/16: Dialogue no longer works with Stardew update 1.1. Will put a notice in this descripton when I update the file. Any modder may feel free to edit and upload my files in any way they choose, no credit needed.

This mod replaces Samson with Samantha, a gender swapped version of Sam with a colorful new outfit! It also changes some dialogue, so Sam's family will refer to her with female pronouns.

Dialogue changes may not be complete. Please let me know if you find any errors, or any references to Sam with male pronouns that I missed.

To install, extract to Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley.

Downloads.Description: Includes portrait, sprite, and dialogue. Fixes pronouns missed in 1.0.
